verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a Dashboard verification detail page with an Override Result button for failed sessions, plus per-session status, granular risk assessments and the main risk factors. A STATUS_UPDATED webhook exists, which plausibly carries reviewer overrides back to integrators. However, nothing describes a dedicated queue that routes borderline cases to human review, or a reviewer view of document images and extracted fields. Missing for 10: an explicit manual review queue or routing of borderline cases, evidence that document images and extracted fields appear in the review view, explicit confirmation that reviewer decisions update the record and trigger webhooks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
